header: Quotes from the shippers on our nightly runs

testimonials.quote: Bonded paperwork stays at the Eindhoven depot now. Clearance runs 41 minutes on average and I have not driven to a border post since 2024.
Sawn timber is awkward, long and heavy. They rebuilt the loading pattern with us on the yard and we have not lost a bundle in 14 months.
The winter rate held at EUR 118 a pallet while spot quotes doubled. Weekend collections still need three days’ notice, which is my one complaint.
